ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Set`, which initialises its local `reps` to 0, and `Counting` inside it.
`rest` leaves `Set` for `Resting`. `shown` is an output and keeps its value, 2.
A press starts the next set. Entering `Set` resets `reps` to 0; `total` is not declared in `Set` and keeps 2.
The first rep of the new set: `reps` restarts at 1, but `total` is 3. `total` is declared at the top of the chart, outside `Set`, so entering `Set` does not reset it.
